subject: URGENT - fryer down mid lunch service
body:
Hi,

Our twin tank fryer just died. Won't heat, pilot keeps going out and there's a gas smell near the left tank so we've shut it off. We're in the middle of lunch and have a function booked for 6pm tonight.

Can someone get a tech out TODAY please? Call me on the shop number, I'm on the pass and can't check email much.

Ben
Carter's Burgers

extracted.summary: Ben reports a twin tank fryer that won't heat, with a gas smell, and wants a technician out today before a 6pm function.

draft_reply:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for getting in touch, and sorry to hear the fryer is down mid-service. We've flagged this as urgent.

Safety first: please keep the fryer off. If the gas smell continues or gets stronger, turn off the gas supply at the isolation valve, ventilate the area, and call the gas emergency line or 000 if needed.

Please call our 24/7 emergency breakdown line on 1300 000 427 now so a technician can be dispatched as quickly as possible. That is the fastest way to get someone to you.

We can't promise a specific arrival time by email, but the team will confirm directly by phone.

Kind regards,
Harbour & Co Operations
